يرتبطوا (form VIII)
# يَرْتَبِطُوا (yartabiṭū) /jar.ta.bi.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# يُرْتَبَطُوا (yurtabaṭū) /jur.ta.ba.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
